name: WP Zillow Review Slider
author: jgwhite33

sections.description:
Show Zillow Reviews on Your WordPress Site in Minutes.

This plugin downloads your Zillow realtor reviews and stores them in your WordPress database on your own server. Your site serves those reviews locally for fast loading and a smooth visitor experience — no external API calls on every page view.

Create a review slider or grid that showcases client feedback for your real estate business. Each review can display the Zillow logo so visitors know the reviews are verified social proof.

Perfect for realtors with a Zillow profile. Use a shortcode or widget to place reviews on your homepage, landing pages, or agent bio pages.

Currently the free version supports Realtor reviews. It does not work with Mortgage, Contractor, or other Zillow profile types.

Feature List:

  • Lightweight plugin code designed for speed.
  • Download Zillow reviews and store them locally on your server.
  • Display reviews in a slider, grid, or rows.
  • Mobile-friendly responsive design.
  • Use on a Page or Post with a shortcode or widget.
  • Create unlimited review templates for different areas of your site.
  • Customize colors, border radius, show/hide stars and dates, and custom CSS per template.
  • Hide reviews that do not include text.
  • Sort reviews randomly or by newest.
  • Show multiple reviews per row with multiple rows.

Download your reviews manually whenever you want. The Pro version can automatically check for new Zillow reviews on a daily schedule and download from multiple profiles.

I personally support all of my plugins and appreciate every customer. If you have any questions, don’t hesitate to ask!

sections.installation:
1. Upload the wp-zillow-review-slider folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open WP Zillow in your admin menu.
  4. Go to Get Zillow Reviews to download your reviews.
  5. Visit Review List to confirm reviews were imported.
  6. Create a template on the Templates page and add the shortcode to a post or page.
sections.faq:
Are reviews stored on my server?

Yes. When you download, Zillow reviews are saved in your WordPress database and loaded from your site — not pulled from Zillow on every page view.

Does the free version download reviews automatically every day?

No. The free version downloads reviews when you click Save Settings & Download on the Get Zillow Reviews page. Daily automatic downloads are available in the Pro version.

Can I use this for non-realtor Zillow profiles?

The free version is designed for Zillow Realtor reviews. Mortgage, Contractor, and other profile types are supported in the Pro version.

Zillow is blocking my download. What can I do?

Zillow sometimes blocks review downloads from certain hosting environments. The Pro version uses a different download method that continues to work for most customers.
